# Learning the Data

## Loading files and reading the data

```{r, message=FALSE}
# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(readr)


# Read csv files containing the attendance data
all_years_files <- 
  # rules for how to search the folder
  list.files(
    path = "MDSDATA",
    # see: regular expressions
    pattern = ".csv$" ,
    full.names = TRUE
  )

all_years_data <- setNames(
  lapply(all_years_files, read_csv),
  basename(all_years_files))

head(all_years_data, 4)
```

## Cleaning the Data

### 2008-2009

```{r}

y1 <- all_years_data[["2008Fall.csv"]] |>
  mutate(
    Date = Date |>
      str_remove("\\.") |>
      str_replace("$", " 2008") |>
      mdy()
  )

  
y1

# switch to mm/dd/yyyy format for date


```
